cases.input: A five-chapter subtractive revision addresses an award blocker without changing events, character decisions, dragon agency or reveal order.
requiredBehaviors: classify the delta by changed narrative function rather than word count alone
run targeted regression against the blocker and protect constraints
record residual nonblocking watchpoints separately from blockers
forbiddenBehaviors: rerun every gate automatically because five files changed
close the blocker without checking collateral damage
treat fewer words as proof that the root cause is fixed
skillAnchors: Kein Full Rerun ohne funktionalen Grund

cases.input: A single paragraph changes the protagonist's reason for the final sacrifice.
requiredBehaviors: classify a small textual delta as high narrative impact
invalidate affected arc and reader-reality evidence
require appropriate reader and continuity reruns before publication freeze
forbiddenBehaviors: classify the change as R1 merely because it is one paragraph
keep old reader gates valid when the causal basis of the ending changed
skillAnchors: Publication Freeze verwendet nur aktuell gültige Gates

cases.input: A revision fixes a pacing complaint but removes the only scene proving a secondary character can leave freely.
requiredBehaviors: detect collateral damage to protected agency
fail closure of the revision despite pacing improvement
require a smaller or alternative intervention that preserves the protected function
forbiddenBehaviors: mark regression pass solely because the original pacing finding improved
discard protect constraints as subjective preferences
skillAnchors: Ein Finding gilt nicht als geschlossen
